known_gaps.reason: The IP scaffold still names scripts/check.sh, but this worktree has no scripts/check.sh. The canonical local pre-PR entrypoint used here is oya verify --ci-required.
This ChangeSet adds Cedar policy bind app composition only; SSO/federation runtime contracts remain required before M03-P01-IP-004 is complete.
Existing Cloud IAM API STS tests are green, but runtime/provider expansion beyond the existing API surface is intentionally not claimed by this Cedar bind ChangeSet.

findings: bind_cedar_policy validates request id, tenant id, request/role tenant match, role policy id/version match, and tenant-scoped policy match before cloning commits.
Both domain kernel mutations are committed only after policy publish and role create succeed on transaction clones.
Integration tests cover transactional success, role/policy mismatch with no mutation, and rollback when IAM rejects missing assumable principal.
Final app crate depends only on domain crates; architecture-boundaries passed and forbids the rejected app->api shape.
New app request/response/error structs are additive and do not alter existing cloud.iam or policy.cedar API contracts.
Small domain-composition crate follows existing workspace lint/test patterns and adds no third-party dependency.
Response metadata carries request_id, tenant_id, policy id/version, role id, and schema version for audit correlation without credentials.
No provider credentials, external SDKs, network calls, or secret payloads are introduced; request fields remain internal-only except public schema/data classifications already owned by domain types.
The transaction uses bounded in-memory clone/commit over domain state and adds no hot-path I/O or unbounded provider loop.
Cross-kernel Cedar/IAM binding is centralized in one app seam instead of duplicating partial-commit handling in handlers.
ChangeSet is isolated to one new app crate, catalog row, workspace/lockfile rows, plan status, and evidence.
IP-004 and P01 index record Cedar-bind app composition green while explicitly preserving SSO/STS follow-up work.
Review caught and removed the tempting app->api dependency shape; final evidence avoids claiming full IP completion.
Oya VCS claim/work accepted before evidence and plan writes; verify/done/promote remains the closeout path.

Promotion status was written back to both evidence files and the audit-chain.
Removed cross-layer special case: handlers do not need to coordinate policy and role partial commits.
Rejected preserving app->api calls after architecture-boundaries exposed the forbidden edge.
IAM role binding now composes Cedar policy state without coupling to any cloud provider runtime, preserving provider-agnostic control-plane design.
